Subject : Update on the Conference Call in respect of Financial Results for the quarter ended 
June 30, 2026 
 
 
Dear Sir/Madam,  
 
In furtherance of our letter dated July 24, 2026, informing the Exchanges regarding the Earnings call in 
respect of the Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, we wish to inform 
that the said conference call was held today, i.e., August 06, 2026.  
The presentation made to the participants has already been disclosed to the Exchanges vide our letter 
dated August 05, 2026. The audio recording of Paisalo's Q1FY27 Earnings call has been hosted on the 
website of the Company and is available at https://paisalo.in/Content/Audio/ArihantCap-Paisalo-Earnings-
Aug06-2026.mp3 
We request you to take the same on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For Paisalo Digital Limited 
 
 
 
(MANENDRA SINGH) 
Company Secretary
